text:
sam-infra: Kickoff — BlueWave private VPC bring-up in ap-southeast-1. Target window: Thu 03/26 02:00 UTC. Plan: seed images via air-gap relay, provision GPU pool (4xA100-80G), BGP peer to customer edge, validate KV cache performance. Need CIDR + contact.

tina-net: BlueWave gave 10.240.0.0/16 for internal. We should avoid 10.240.32.0/19 (used elsewhere). Recommend /22 for worker subnets. BGP or static? prefer BGP if they can advertise.

maria-ops: Quick checklist (short):
1) Seed images to bootstrap host
2) Verify image checksums
3) Run node installer (air-gapped)
4) Configure VPC routing + firewall
5) Bring up GPU daemonset + nvlink checks
6) Perf smoke + sample inference
7) Cost tags + quota alerts

sanford-eng: Commands for seeding:
```
# on seed machine
scp redwood-images.tar.gz root@seed-host:/opt/images/
ssh root@seed-host 'sha256sum /opt/images/redwood-images.tar.gz'
redwood-seed --images /opt/images/redwood-images.tar.gz --validate
```
Logs show exit 0 on my dry run.

craig-qa: GPU validation script (quick):
```
# run on a worker
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv
python perf_token_test.py --tokens 1024 --batch 8
```
Expect latency < 40ms / token p50 on 1xA100-80G baseline. Report results back.

deploy-bot: [deploy] seed-job started at 2026-03-20T14:12:45Z - job-id: d8f3b2

maria-ops: Note on networking — saw MTU mismatch during recent site bring-up: please set expected MTU=9000 on worker NICs and ensure edge NAT uses jumbo frames. Traceroute earlier showed fragmentation.

tina-net: sample traceroute snippet:
```
traceroute -n 10.240.0.10
 1 10.240.0.1 0.3 ms
 2 192.0.2.1 1.2 ms  (edge fw)
```
Edge FW is dropping icmp fragments — will open ticket with customer firewall team.

maria-ops: Cost note: ap-southeast-1 reserved pricing is ~1.12x us-west baseline. Recommend 2x spot fallback pools + 1 reserved pool for production SLA. Tagging: customer:bluewave, env:prod, pool:bluewave-gpu

sam-infra: Schedule: seed done by Tue EOD, node install Wed, smoke Thu in maintenance window. Need @tina-net + @craig-qa signoff. :eyes:

tina-net: :thumbsup: I can approve after I see BGP session up and one traceroute showing path

craig-qa: I'll run perf tests Wed night and post p50/p95 numbers. If p95 > 200ms we'll investigate.

maria-ops: Also: handoff checklist to support (short):
- runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bluewave-vpc
- oncall: @infra-oncall
- rollback: disable dedicated pool -> route to hosted fallback

sam-infra: Great. I'll update runbook and ping customer for final maintenance window. Ending thread — post results here. :rocket:
